vocabulary.meaning_en: peaceful and satisfied with your life
vocabulary.example: I'm content with my simple life.

vocabulary.meaning_en: pleased because you have what you want or need
vocabulary.example: She is satisfied with her new job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feeling thankful because someone did something kind for you
vocabulary.note_ar: grateful for + شيء / grateful to + شخص
vocabulary.note_en: grateful for something, grateful to someone
vocabulary.example: I'm grateful to my mother for the soup she made when I was sick.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very pleased; something gives you great pleasure
vocabulary.example: I would be delighted to visit you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a feeling of happiness and enjoyment

vocabulary.example: The light from the sun is intense.
She was ecstatic when she got the job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not happy or satisfied with your situation
vocabulary.example: He is discontent with his job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: tired of a problem and not able to accept it any more
vocabulary.note_ar: fed up with + شيء. fed هو ماضي feed (يُطعم)
vocabulary.note_en: fed up with something. "Fed" is the past of "feed".
vocabulary.example: I'm fed up with the noise from the street.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very annoyed by something that keeps happening
vocabulary.example: I'm sick and tired of waiting for the bus.

vocabulary.meaning_en: upset because you can't do what you want
vocabulary.example: I'm frustrated because I can't understand fast speakers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very sad for a long time; it may need medical help
vocabulary.note_en: A serious word; use it carefully.
vocabulary.example: If someone is depressed for months, they should see a doctor.
He felt miserable in the cold rain.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not able to understand or decide
having different feelings at the same time; confused
vocabulary.example: I got the promotion, but I feel mixed up about moving away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: two feelings that fight each other, like happy and sad together
vocabulary.example: Leaving home gave me conflicting emotions.

fine_lines.title: content → grateful → delighted → ecstatic
fine_lines.explanation_ar: content: هادئ وراضٍ عن نفسك. grateful: سعيد لأن شخصًا فعل لك شيئًا جميلًا. delighted: شيء ما يمنحك سرورًا كبيرًا. ecstatic: في قمة السعادة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Content: calm and satisfied. Grateful: happy because someone did something kind. Delighted: something gives you great pleasure. Ecstatic: extremely happy.

examples.sentence: I'm content at home with a good book.
He was ecstatic about his new baby.

fine_lines.title: fed up vs frustrated
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fed up: سئمت من مشكلة ولا أريد التعامل معها بعد الآن. frustrated: أحاول فعل شيء لكن شيئًا ما يمنعني.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Fed up: I am tired of a problem and want no more of it. Frustrated: I try to do something, but something stops me.

examples.sentence: I'm fed up with this slow computer.
I'm frustrated because my visa is late.

fine_lines.title: sad vs depressed
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sad حزن عادي ليوم أو يومين. depressed حزن شديد لفترة طويلة (أسابيع أو أشهر) وقد يحتاج علاجًا طبيًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Sad is normal sadness for a day or two. Depressed is deep sadness for weeks or months; it may need medical help.

examples.sentence: I was sad when my friend moved away.
He has been depressed for months, so he is seeing a doctor.

expressions.meaning_en: a polite, happy way to accept an invitation
expressions.example: Would you like to come for dinner? - I would be delighted.

expressions.meaning_en: I can't accept this problem any more
expressions.example: I'm fed up with the traffic in this city.

expressions.meaning_en: I'm very annoyed by something that keeps happening
expressions.example: I'm sick and tired of you leaving your shoes everywhere.
The food was great, but not another bite!

expressions.meaning_en: good and bad feelings at the same time
expressions.example: I have mixed emotions about leaving my old school.
Content is good, but let's move it up a notch: grateful.

grammar.title: Feeling adjectives + prepositions
grammar.explanation_ar: بعض صفات المشاعر يأتي بعدها حرف جر محدد: grateful for (شيء) / grateful to (شخص)، fed up with، sick and tired of، frustrated with/about، confused by/about، delighted to + فعل.
grammar.explanation_en: Many feeling adjectives take a fixed preposition: grateful for (thing) / to (person), fed up with, sick and tired of, frustrated with/about, confused by/about, delighted to + verb.
examples: She's fed up with her noisy neighbours.

grammar.title: -ed vs -ing adjectives: frustrated / frustrating
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفة المنتهية بـ -ed تصف شعور الشخص (I'm frustrated)، والمنتهية بـ -ing تصف الشيء الذي يسبب الشعور (This is frustrating).
grammar.explanation_en: -ed describes how a person feels (I'm frustrated). -ing describes the thing that causes the feeling (It's frustrating).
examples: Listening to fast speakers is frustrating.
I'm confused. The lesson is confusing.

questions.question: Your friend brings you soup when you are sick. You feel ___.
questions.explanation_ar: grateful = ممتن لأن أحدًا فعل لك شيئًا لطيفًا.

questions.question: "I'm ___ with this noise. I can't take it any more!"
questions.explanation_en: Fed up with = can't accept it any more.

questions.question: You try again and again but can't open the door. You feel ___.
questions.explanation_ar: frustrated = محبط لأنك لا تستطيع فعل ما تريد.
questions.explanation_en: Frustrated = you can't do what you want.

questions.question: "Would you like to visit us?" - "I would be ___."
questions.explanation_ar: I would be delighted طريقة مهذبة لقبول الدعوة.

questions.question: Which word is very serious and means sad for a long time?
questions.explanation_en: Depressed = very sad for a long time.

questions.question: "I'm sick and tired ___ waiting."
questions.explanation_en: We say sick and tired of.

questions.question: You got a new job, but you must move far from your family. You have ___.
questions.explanation_en: Good and bad feelings together = mixed emotions.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I'm frustrated because I can't find my keys.
questions.explanation_en: -ed for the person's feeling; -ing for the cause.
